HAYKALAH works through four specialist sub-brands and builds ventures of its own.

Four specialist sub-brands work inside one structuring house, and HAYKALAH also builds ventures of its own. The ventures put HAYKALAH’s model into practice: we advise, then stay to build, operate and own a share of what we structure. The archive census counts 108 ventures, technology apps and platforms, 2004–2026.

Census counts are indicative.

How we create value

  • 01

    Innovation

    NATHARAH takes the waqf-manager model that HAYKALAH has built since 2010 into a venture of its own, and Cyber HAYKALAH works with HAYKALAH’s digital practice on the tools it builds in-house and with partners.

  • 06

    Commercialization

    A 2010 parking study became Arsann, an operating company that HAYKALAH’s founder built and sold to a Saudi investment group in 2023, and AS3A took a flexible-work model to market as an operating platform with signed client agreements.

From advice to ownership

The ventures follow the commercial model in HAYKALAH’s record. From 2013 to 2019 it moved to board seats and principal ventures, and since 2024 it has added equity-for-build, with partner equity vesting at agreed gates. Our approach explains how the method works.

We are not choosing between advisory and ownership. We are using advisory and execution to create the value.

Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

Questions

What are HAYKALAH’s sub-brands?

FINA. (financial structuring), MARK. (market impact), AXIS. (access) and AGTI. (AI precision farming). Each one keeps its full stop and works inside HAYKALAH.

Which ventures has HAYKALAH built?

HAYKALAH’s own ventures include NATHARAH, built on the waqf-manager model; Cyber HAYKALAH, a cybersecurity venture; AS3A, a flexible-work platform that is operating; and Arsann, a parking operator that HAYKALAH’s founder built and sold in 2023.

Can I invest in a HAYKALAH venture through this website?

No. Nothing on this website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice. Where a transaction involves an offer of securities, that activity is carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for the transaction.

Does HAYKALAH build ventures with other founders?

Yes. HAYKALAH joins founders, private investors and international companies as an institutional co-founder, from validation to capital readiness.
